maddeler.e:
يعترضا (form VIII)
# يَعْتَرِضَا (yaʕtariḍā) /jaʕ.ta.ri.dˤaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# يُعْتَرَضَا (yuʕtaraḍā) /juʕ.ta.ra.dˤaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
